org.tmt.aps.peas.common

Class Utils

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.common.Utils

  • public class Utils
extends Object
    General Utilities for PEAS PCS: includes static functions for generating exception messages for screen display and logging, Futures waiting, Thread sleeping and data formatting for viewable output.
    Author:
    smichaels

      • reformatData

        public static String reformatData(String value,
                  FieldDescriptor fieldDescriptor)
        Generates a data value display string given a FieldDescriptor and string representation of the value.
        Parameters:
        value - string representation of the value, this is how procedure outputs and field values are stored in the database.
        fieldDescriptor - the description of the field, including data type and dimension
        Returns:
        the message to display
        See Also:
        ProcedureOutputValue.getDataFormatted(), FrameFieldDisplay.getDataFormatted()
